# jumpcloud_application (Data Source)

Looks up a JumpCloud SSO application, such as one created in the admin console, by its label. Fails unless exactly one application matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find an application created in the admin console.
data "jumpcloud_application" "aws" {
  display_label = "AWS IAM Identity Center"
}

# Give its IdP details to the service provider.
output "aws_saml_metadata" {
  value = {
    sso_url     = data.jumpcloud_application.aws.sso_url
    entity_id   = data.jumpcloud_application.aws.idp_entity_id
    certificate = data.jumpcloud_application.aws.idp_certificate
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_label` (String) Label shown in the admin console, matched exactly and case-sensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `idp_certificate` (String) IdP signing certificate in PEM of a SAML application. Empty for other types.
- `idp_entity_id` (String) IdP entity ID of a SAML application. Empty for other types.
- `show_in_portal` (Boolean) Whether the application appears in users' JumpCloud portal.
- `sso_url` (String) IdP single sign-on URL of a SAML application, or the target URL of a bookmark. Empty for OIDC applications.
- `template` (String) Catalog template the application was created from, such as `saml2`, `oidc`, `bookmark`, or the name of a catalog app.
- `type` (String) Sign-in protocol: `saml`, `oidc`, or `bookmark`.
